title: PursuitPlan
description: The convergence object of Path A (designated structure) and Path B (free-flow). Approved by a human at Gate 2 (Plan). Absorbs v1's mapping-plan/coverage-ledger role: per-section KB grounding, gaps as first-class human tasks, and the coverage surface QA reads from.

slots_ref.description: Path A: pointer to the parsed TargetSlot[] file (v1 target-slot.schema.json, reused unchanged).

effort_allocation.description: Launch = uniform (decision V4). 'weighted' drives depth by requirements_matrix weights — v2.1 flag.

source.description: Where this section came from — buyer's structure, the firm reference outline, or added by the Outline Architect for this deal.

slot_ids.description: Path A: TargetSlots this section answers.

requirement_refs.description: requirements_matrix refs this section covers (coverage ledger).

win_themes.description: Approved themes threaded into this section.

kb_hits.description: Grounding retrieved by the Internal Researcher / KB Mapper.

kb_id.description: Card-catalog id of the KB document/passage.

gaps.description: Present when the KB came up empty or thin — first-class human tasks, never silently invented around. One item per flagged gap (B24: the human disposes; nothing is preselected).

gap_id.description: Join key to the run-log gap record (false_gap_rate / gap_resolution_hours source). Required by code on every written item.

slot_id.description: Path A: the TargetSlot this gap blocks. Required by code on slot-scoped gaps (B37/E1) — replaces the ping-text prefix-match (B31(11)); Path-B/section-scoped gaps omit it.

note.description: The human's disposition note (draft_flagged / omit_approved). Distinct from reframe.note, which is the reframe direction.

reframe.description: Present only when status == reframed. mandatory_review is code-forced true — a reframe is never preselected and always reviewed (B24).

note.description: The reframe direction the human chose.

precedents.description: Advisory cross-pursuit hints derived from approved sibling plans (B28): what grounded the same question/section before. Never auto-applied.

pursuit_id.description: The prior pursuit whose approved plan matched.

section_id.description: The matching section in the prior plan.

kb_ids.description: The prior section's kb_hits — what grounded it before.

note.description: Code-composed match basis (exact question / exact title).

based_on.description: Path B: the reference-outline section(s) this section adapts (B28(8) carrier, decided at P9/E1) — an array because the architect may merge reference sections (outline.py whitelist-parses the list). Absent on client_structure and architect_added sections — absence means the section answers the buyer or the architect, not the reference.

obligations.description: The service-line manifest rendered as the Gate-2 checklist (B16 consumer): every obligation covered by a section or flagged gapped. coverage_summary derives from plan content.

section_ids.description: Sections whose content covers this obligation.

note.description: Required by code when status == waived (Gate-2 waive_obligation op, B37/D25): the human's reason. A waived obligation is NOT covered — the recount keeps them apart.

draft_flagged.description: Gaps the human authorized for flagged LLM drafting (B24). Deliberately NOT counted covered — acceleration, not coverage.

created.description: Stamped only by Gate 2 with the injected decision time (B19(8)/B22(8) pattern) — the plan carries no wall-clock before the gate.

gates_collapsed.description: True when Gates 1+2 were approved on one screen (small-deal toggle).

request_sha256.description: Digest of the semantic decision request (decision, notes, edits/answers/corrections/skips, org, gates_collapsed — never the clock or per-submission transport). Written at the stamp so a mid-gate crash resubmit converges on the SAME request and refuses a different one (P25 item 1, register P0-5). Optional: a stamp without it converges on (status, actor) alone.
